name: ditto-node-workflow-search
description: Node-to-Graph-to-Loop workflow search experiments built on the public Ditto npm package.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules --test --test-concurrency=2 dist/test/*.test.js dist/benchmark/*.test.js scripts/night_watchdog.test.mjs
scripts.search:drop: npm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/unified/cli.js search --dataset drop
scripts.search:drop:legacy: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js search --dataset drop
scripts.search:humaneval: npm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/unified/cli.js search --dataset humaneval
scripts.search:mbpp: npm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/unified/cli.js search --dataset mbpp
scripts.search:gsm8k: npm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/unified/cli.js search --dataset gsm8k
scripts.search:math: npm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/unified/cli.js search --dataset math
scripts.search: npm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/unified/cli.js search
scripts.test:frozen: npm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/unified/cli.js test
scripts.experiment:legacy:a: npm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/coding/drop-small.js --method a
scripts.experiment:legacy:small: npm run build && node --experimental-vm-modules --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/coding/drop-small.js --method b
